name: SA01
summary: EngineAI's cheap full-height platform: an aluminum frame on high-torque harmonic joint modules, sold from around $5,300 on an open platform for research and teaching. It runs and jumps, recovers balance from a shove or a kick, and carries RealSense depth cameras, 360° LiDAR and dual NVIDIA/Intel compute.

sources.title: SA01 humanoid robot from EngineAI — Robotic Gizmos
